scripts.dev:full: pnpm db:migrate:local && pnpm build && wrangler dev .output/server/index.mjs --assets .output/public -c wrangler.dev.jsonc --port 3000
scripts.release:installer: pnpm build:site && pnpm build:deployment && node scripts/build-installer-release.mjs && pnpm --filter @llll/deployment-core pack --pack-destination .installer/release
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local -c wrangler.dev.jsonc
scripts.build:deployment: pnpm build && pnpm exec wrangler deploy --dry-run --minify --config wrangler.installer.jsonc --outdir .installer/bundle && node scripts/build-deployment-release.mjs
scripts.test:server: node scripts/test-github-agent.mjs && node scripts/test-server.mjs && node scripts/test-server.mjs --basic

AUTH_SECRET.description: Generate a random 32+ character value. This signs login sessions.

CF_ACCESS_ISS.description: Cloudflare Access team issuer, such as https://team.cloudflareaccess.com.

APP_NAME.description: Name shown beside the L4 logo and in the page title.

APP_TITLE.description: Login headline. Use \n to split it across two lines.

APP_SUBTITLE.description: Supporting copy shown below the login headline.

AUTH_REGISTRATION_MODE.description: Initial signup policy: invite_only (default) or open. The owner can change it later.

EMAIL_FROM.description: Optional verified Cloudflare Email Service sender. An EMAIL send binding is also required.

EMAIL_FROM_NAME.description: Optional display name for verification emails.

GITHUB_AGENT_APP_ID.description: Optional dedicated GitHub App ID for governed code environments, separate from login OAuth.

GITHUB_AGENT_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Secret PEM private key of the dedicated agent GitHub App. Never forwarded to compute.

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional GitHub OAuth client ID. Deployment credentials override settings entered in L4.

TWITTER_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional OAuth 2.0 client ID for Sign in with X. Configure `/api/auth/callback/twitter` as the callback path.

TWITTER_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional OAuth 2.0 client secret for Sign in with X.

TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.description: Optional Cloudflare Turnstile site key for email signup.

TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY.description: Optional Cloudflare Turnstile secret key for email signup.

REALTIMEKIT_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Optional RealtimeKit account ID. Deployment credentials override settings entered in L4.

VAPID_SUBJECT.description: Web Push contact URI, normally mailto:admin@example.com.

VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Stable URL-safe P-256 public key generated by pnpm vapid:generate.

VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Stable URL-safe P-256 private key. Store this as a secret.

ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Email for the first owner account.

SETUP_TOKEN.description: Optional private 32+ character claim used to create the first owner on the server domain.

AGENT_MODEL.description: Default Workers AI model for server agents. The included default is @cf/moonshotai/kimi-k2.7-code.

AI_BASE_URL.description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions base URL, used when the AI binding is absent. Include /v1 when the server expects it.

AI_API_KEY.description: Secret for AI_BASE_URL. Store this as a secret.

AI_MODEL.description: Model id sent to AI_BASE_URL when Workers AI is not bound and Cloudflare REST credentials are absent.

CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Cloudflare account id for Workers AI, Browser Run, Email Sending, and RealtimeKit REST calls when those bindings are absent. A 32-character hex id. Store the matching token as a secret.

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.description: Secret. API token for CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID. Workers AI Read and Edit, Browser Run Edit (or Browser Rendering Edit), Email Sending Edit, and Realtime Admin.

BROWSER_CDP_URL.description: Chromium DevTools endpoint used when the BROWSER binding is absent. http(s) base or ws(s) browser socket. Keep it private.

MAIL_GATEWAY_URL.description: HTTP endpoint that accepts L4's outbound mail JSON when no email binding is present.

SMTP_GATEWAY_URL.description: HTTP endpoint that relays L4's outbound mail JSON over SMTP. Inbound mail uses INBOUND_EMAIL_SECRET or a provider webhook.

SMTP_GATEWAY_TOKEN.description: Bearer token for SMTP_GATEWAY_URL. Store this as a secret.

INBOUND_EMAIL_SECRET.description: Secret of at least 32 characters for POST /api/email/inbound. The Email Routing bridge signs with the same value.

POSTMARK_INBOUND_SECRET.description: HTTP Basic password for POST /api/email/inbound/postmark. At least 32 characters. Store this as a secret.

MAILGUN_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_KEY.description: Mailgun HTTP webhook signing key for POST /api/email/inbound/mailgun. At least 32 characters. Not the API key.

SES_SNS_TOPIC_ARN.description: Amazon SNS topic ARN allowed to POST /api/email/inbound/ses. Example: arn:aws:sns:<region>:<account>:llll-inbound.

LLLL_RUNTIME.description: Set to celld on non-Cloudflare Workers runtimes. Inbound mail then uses INBOUND_EMAIL_SECRET or a Postmark, Mailgun, or Amazon SES webhook. Calls, Workers AI, Browser Run, and outbound mail can use CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID and CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN. cloudflare or workers keeps Cloudflare-network features.

REALTIMEKIT_API_TOKEN.description: Optional Cloudflare API token with Realtime permissions. Store this as a secret.
